title: DINOv2 for PET: A Pre-Training Domain Benchmark Across Classification, Segmentation, and Prognosis
zh_title: PET-DINOv2：跨分类、分割与预后的预训练领域基准
summary: 首个在2D PET图像上预训练的DINOv2模型，与自然图像及CT/MRI预训练编码器在分类、分割、预后任务上统一对比。
key_points: 提出首个2D PET自监督预训练DINOv2模型
与原始DINOv2、OmniRad在同一轻量头上对比
预训练数据更少但性能相当或更优；为预印本
reason: 有新意的预印本方法且对比充分，但无外部临床验证，未经同行评审
abstract: DINO (self-DIstillation with NO labels) has become a stan- dard for self-supervised pre-training, producing features that generalise across datasets and downstream tasks. In medical imaging it has been adopted mainly for radiology (X-ray, CT and MRI), where even natural- image DINO features transfer well. In the literature, these features have been reported to transfer worse to functional imaging such as PET. Yet PET-specific DINO models have barely been introduced, and even less validated across multiple tasks and datasets. We present PET-DINOv2-2D, the first DINOv2 model pre-trained on 2D PET, and benchmark it against open-source encoders: the origi- nal DINOv2 (pre-trained on the LVD-142M natural-image dataset) and OmniRad (pre-trained on CT, MRI and ultrasound). Using the same lightweight heads for every backbone, and despite far less pre-training data, PET-DINOv2-2D matches or outperforms both on three down- stream PET tasks: normal/abnormal classification, lesion segmentation and recurrence-free survival prognosis. Its advantage is largest when few labels are available, suggesting that PET pre-training gives more transferable, label-efficient features. Code is made available at https://github.com/nuclivision/pet-dinov2-2d/.
zh_abstract: DINO（self-DIstillation with NO labels，无标签自蒸馏）已成为自监督预训练的标准，产生的特征可泛化到不同数据集和下游任务。在医学影像中，它主要用于放射学（X线、CT和MRI），即使自然图像DINO特征也能很好地迁移。文献报道，这些特征向PET等功能性成像的迁移效果较差。然而，PET特异性DINO模型几乎尚未被引入，在多个任务和数据集上的验证更少。我们提出PET-DINOv2-2D，这是首个在2D PET上预训练的DINOv2模型，并将其与开源编码器进行基准比较：原始DINOv2（在LVD-142M自然图像数据集上预训练）和OmniRad（在CT、MRI和超声上预训练）。每个骨干网络使用相同的轻量级头，尽管预训练数据少得多，PET-DINOv2-2D在三个下游PET任务上匹配或优于两者：正常/异常分类、病灶分割和无复发生存预后。当可用标签很少时，其优势最大，表明PET预训练提供了更具可迁移性、标签高效的特征。代码见 https://github.com/nuclivision/pet-dinov2-2d/。

title: Integrating Heterogeneous Echocardiography AI Outputs in Language Space: Learnable Late Fusion with a Supervised LLM
zh_title: 用受监督LLM在语言空间融合超声心动图AI输出
summary: arXiv预印本提出基于受监督大语言模型的晚期融合模块，在语言空间整合不同切面超声心动图AI的发现与测量输出。
key_points: 将异质模型输出统一为语言形式的发现陈述与测量值
646名患者859次检查的患者级三折交叉验证
性能与最佳参考融合策略相当，优于无监督通用LLM
reason: 有新方法且有基线对比，但仅内部交叉验证的预印本
abstract: View- and target-specific echocardiography AI models capture useful but complementary information and may not achieve sufficient predictive performance in isolation. A learned ensemble is a natural way to combine these outputs, but heterogeneous models typically require each output to be converted into a binary decision, probability, confidence score, or fixed-length feature vector. We developed a supervised large language model (LLM)-based late-fusion module that directly aggregates view-specific predicted finding statements and predicted measurements in language space and learns a case-level fusion function. In patient-level three-fold cross-validation of 859 examinations from 646 patients, the proposed method integrated heterogeneous outputs within a single framework, performed comparably to the best-performing reference strategy evaluated, and outperformed a general-purpose LLM without task-specific training. These results suggest that a supervised LLM can combine multiple upstream models without model-specific output conversion or feature engineering that requires medical knowledge.
zh_abstract: 视图特异性和目标特异性的超声心动图 AI 模型可捕捉有用但互补的信息，单独使用时可能无法达到足够的预测性能。学习式集成是组合这些输出的自然方式，但异质性模型通常要求将每个输出转换为二分类决策、概率、置信度分数或固定长度特征向量。我们开发了一个基于监督式大语言模型（LLM）的晚期融合（late-fusion）模块，该模块在语言空间中直接聚合视图特异性的预测发现陈述和预测测量值，并学习病例级融合函数。在来自 646 名患者的 859 次检查的患者级三折交叉验证中，所提方法在单一框架内整合了异质性输出，性能与所评估的表现最佳的参考策略相当，并优于未经任务特定训练的通用 LLM。这些结果表明，监督式 LLM 可以组合多个上游模型，而无需进行模型特定的输出转换或需要医学知识的特征工程。

title: Radiology Guideline-derived Decision Graph for Efficient Clinical Decision Support
zh_title: 由放射学指南生成决策图以支持临床决策
summary: 预印本提出GDGraph框架，用大模型将指南编译为可执行决策图，在肾囊肿、附件包块与甲状腺结节共347例上做可追溯推理。
key_points: 将分散于正文、表格与定义的指南标准编译为决策图
推理时由轻量模型答局部问题、确定性遍历解析布尔逻辑
覆盖肾囊肿、附件包块、甲状腺结节三个方向347例
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，样本量有限且未见外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Radiological risk stratification and management planning are essential downstream tasks in medical imaging. Automating these tasks is challenging because clinical guideline criteria are distributed across prose, tables, and cross-referenced definitions. We present Guideline-derived Decision Graph (GDGraph), a framework that decouples guideline compilation from case evaluation. During compilation, a large language model partitions guidelines into section-based chunks, extracts local decision subgraphs with linked definitions, and aggregates related branches into an executable decision graph. During inference, a fast System One model answers localized clinical questions while deterministic traversal resolves Boolean logic, turning opaque single-pass predictions into a traceable decision path without task-specific training. Across 347 cases spanning renal cyst, adnexal mass, and thyroid nodule guidelines, GDGraph improves System One accuracy from 57.3% to 90.8%, outperforming retrieval-augmented GPT-4o (80.1%) and graph-guided GPT-4o with chain-of-thought (82.7%) at substantially lower latency and cost. The source code will be available.
zh_abstract: 放射学风险分层和管理规划是医学影像中重要的下游任务。自动化这些任务具有挑战性，因为临床指南标准分布在散文、表格和交叉引用的定义中。我们提出指南衍生决策图（Guideline-derived Decision Graph，GDGraph），一个将指南编译与病例评估解耦的框架。在编译期间，大型语言模型将指南划分为基于章节的文本块，提取带有链接定义的局部决策子图，并将相关分支聚合为可执行决策图。在推理期间，快速 System One 模型回答局部化临床问题，而确定性遍历解析布尔逻辑，将不透明的单次预测转化为可追踪的决策路径，且无需任务特定训练。在涵盖肾囊肿、附件肿块和甲状腺结节指南的 347 个病例中，GDGraph 将 System One 准确率从 57.3% 提高到 90.8%，以显著更低的延迟和成本优于检索增强 GPT-4o（80.1%）和带思维链的图引导 GPT-4o（82.7%）。源代码将公开。

title: Conformal Annotation with Randomized Expert Review: Application to Online Cell-Type Labeling
zh_title: 带随机专家复核的保形标注：用于在线细胞类型标注
summary: 预印本提出CARED框架，通过随机专家抽查实现分布漂移下AI辅助细胞类型标注的长期误差控制。
key_points: 每批均匀抽取部分病例交专家复核并用于校准后续决策
对未复核病例判定可安全跳过人工标注的子集
目标是在分布漂移下维持无分布假设的长期误差控制
reason: 预印本方法学有新意，但缺少大规模外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) models can accelerate cell-type annotation in digital pathology, but safely scaling their use requires determining, with error control, which model-generated labels can be accepted without expert review. This is challenging in evolving workflows because cell morphology and type composition may change across tissue regions and slides, making one-time calibration unreliable. We propose Conformal Annotation with Randomized Expert review under Distribution shift (CARED), a distribution-free framework that leverages randomized expert audit to achieve long-run error control for AI-assisted annotation under distribution shift. For each incoming batch, CARED uniformly selects a subset of cases for expert review and uses the acquired labels to calibrate later decisions. Among unreviewed cases, CARED determines a subset of them to safely skip expert labeling, while suggesting candidate labels for the others for downstream resolution. We prove that this workflow provides long-run control of cumulative error over both the full stream and the cells outside of the audit sample, without stationarity or exchangeability assumptions. We further enhance the framework by introducing class-conditional guarantees to ensure error control within important but rare cell types, together with a utility module to target more automatic resolutions, smaller candidate sets, and greater biological coherence, without compromising validity. Experiments on pancreas, lung, and ovary annotation streams, together with a stream constructed from real expert annotations, show that CARED controls the cumulative errors while a substantial fraction of cells (up to 70%) bypass expert review.
zh_abstract: 人工智能（AI）模型可加速数字病理学中的细胞类型标注，但要安全地扩大其使用范围，就需要在误差控制的前提下确定哪些模型生成的标签可在无需专家复核的情况下被接受。这在不断演变的工作流程中具有挑战性，因为细胞形态和类型组成可能随组织区域和切片而变化，使得一次性校准不可靠。我们提出分布偏移下随机专家复核的保形标注（Conformal Annotation with Randomized Expert review under Distribution shift，CARED），这是一个无分布框架，利用随机专家审计在分布偏移下实现AI辅助标注的长期误差控制。对于每个传入批次，CARED均匀选择一部分病例进行专家复核，并利用获得的标签校准后续决策。在未复核病例中，CARED确定其中一部分可安全跳过专家标注，同时为其余病例建议候选标签以供下游解决。我们证明，该工作流程可在不依赖平稳性或可交换性假设的情况下，对完整数据流和审计样本之外的细胞实现累积误差的长期控制。我们通过引入类别条件保证来进一步增强该框架，以确保在重要但稀有的细胞类型内实现误差控制，并加入一个效用模块，以在不损害有效性的前提下实现更多自动解决、更小的候选集和更高的生物学一致性。在胰腺、肺和卵巢标注数据流以及由真实专家标注构建的数据流上的实验表明，CARED控制了累积误差，同时相当一部分细胞（高达70%）绕过了专家复核。

title: BRIDGE: Learning Brain-Gut Metabolic Evidence for Alzheimer's Disease Diagnosis
zh_title: BRIDGE：脑肠代谢证据迁移用于阿尔茨海默病诊断
summary: 预印本提出两阶段框架，把全身FDG-PET的脑肠配对代谢知识迁移到仅有脑影像的诊断场景。
key_points: 构建条件式脑到肠潜变量迁移模块
采用疾病证据引导的脑通路表征
引入大语言模型辅助的脑通路建模
reason: 新方法预印本，未报告外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) diagnosis may benefit from gut metabolic information associated with brain-gut interactions, yet existing models largely analyze cerebral glucose metabolism alone. Although whole-body fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography (FDG-PET) can provide paired brain-gut observations, routine brain examinations rarely include gut imaging, limiting direct use of this information for diagnosis. In this paper, we present BRIDGE (Brain and Gut Representation Integration via Distribution-Guided Enhancement), a two-stage framework for transferring brain-gut metabolic knowledge to brain-only diagnosis. Specifically, BRIDGE integrates a conditional brain-to-gut latent transport module and a disease-evidence-guided cerebral pathway to capture subject-specific cross-organ correspondence and disease-relevant cerebral representations. For the cerebral pathway, a large language model (LLM) helps organize literature-derived descriptors into human-approved semantic anchors that guide feature learning. Additionally, we introduce a counterfactual-guided residual fusion mechanism, which uses matched and non-matched virtual-gut evidence to supervise a confidence gate and dynamically regulate the contribution of transported cross-organ information. At inference, BRIDGE exploits complementary gut-related context using brain PET alone, without measured gut PET. Extensive experiments across public and private cohorts demonstrate that BRIDGE outperforms brain-only and cross-organ baselines, achieving AUC gains of 6.0% and 5.2% over its brain-only counterpart for CN/MCI and CN/AD diagnosis, respectively. Notably, its ability to transfer complementary brain-gut metabolic context while preserving brain PET as the sole inference input highlights its potential for clinically practical diagnosis. Our code is available at https://github.com/CUHK-AIM-Group/BRIDGE.
zh_abstract: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）诊断可能受益于与脑-肠相互作用相关的肠道代谢信息，但现有模型大多仅分析脑葡萄糖代谢。尽管全身氟脱氧葡萄糖正电子发射断层扫描（FDG-PET）可提供配对的脑-肠观测，常规脑部检查很少包括肠道成像，限制了直接利用该信息进行诊断。本文提出 BRIDGE（Brain and Gut Representation Integration via Distribution-Guided Enhancement），一个将脑-肠代谢知识迁移至仅脑诊断的两阶段框架。具体而言，BRIDGE 整合条件性脑到肠潜在传输模块和疾病证据引导的脑通路，以捕获受试者特异性跨器官对应关系和疾病相关脑表征。对于脑通路，大型语言模型（LLM）帮助将文献衍生的描述符组织为经人类认可的语义锚点，以指导特征学习。此外，我们引入反事实引导的残差融合机制，该机制使用匹配和不匹配的虚拟肠道证据来监督置信门控，并动态调节所传输跨器官信息的贡献。在推理时，BRIDGE 仅使用脑 PET、无需测量的肠道 PET，即可利用互补的肠道相关上下文。在公共和私有队列中的大量实验表明，BRIDGE 优于仅脑和跨器官基线，在 CN/MCI 和 CN/AD 诊断中分别较其仅脑对应模型获得 6.0% 和 5.2% 的 AUC 提升。值得注意的是，其能够在保留脑 PET 作为唯一推理输入的同时迁移互补的脑-肠代谢上下文，突出了其用于临床实用诊断的潜力。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/CUHK-AIM-Group/BRIDGE 获取。

title: Aligning Medical Vision Language Models at the Capability Boundary with Entropy Adaptive Rubric Grounding
zh_title: 医学视觉语言模型按能力边界对齐
summary: 提出MedCBR两阶段对齐框架，用反事实边界偏好优化与评分细则强化学习改进医学视觉语言模型推理。
key_points: 针对边界病例构建反事实偏好对
难度加权边界偏好优化
以评分细则为据的强化学习对齐
reason: 方法思路清晰但为预印本，效果与外部评估信息有限
abstract: Medical diagnostic reasoning requires verifiable links between visual evidence and clinical knowledge, yet current medical vision language models are aligned with objectives that reward the wrong behavior. Uniform supervised fine tuning lets easy cases dominate updates while clinically critical boundary cases saturate prematurely. Sparse rewards based only on final-answer correctness cannot assess anatomical grounding or clinical logic, inviting reward hacking through answer shortcuts. We propose MedCBR, a two-stage alignment framework coupling boundary-aware preference optimization with rubric-grounded reinforcement learning. First, we construct counterfactual boundary preferences at the model's capability frontier using empirical pass rates and preference pairs that share reasoning prefixes but diverge at decisive diagnostic branches. Difficulty Weighted Boundary Preference Optimization (DBPO) concentrates learning on this calibrated boundary region. Second, we distill reusable clinical rubrics from boundary trajectories and activate them according to prediction entropy. Entropy Gated Grounded Policy Optimization (EGPO) rewards answer correctness, anatomical grounding, and reasoning fidelity while suppressing rubric noise on reliable samples. A reference policy anchored to the boundary-aligned model couples population-level boundary priors with instance-level uncertainty, making diagnostic reasoning more accurate and clinically grounded. Experiments on six medical benchmarks show consistent improvements over strong general, specialized, and reinforcement learning baselines, reaching 61.2% average accuracy with the largest gains on challenging differential diagnosis tasks. Ablations show super-additive gains: combining the two stages exceeds the sum of their individual improvements.
zh_abstract: 医学诊断推理需要视觉证据与临床知识之间可验证的关联，但当前的医学视觉语言模型所对齐的目标会奖励错误行为。统一的监督微调使简单病例主导更新，而临床关键的边界病例过早饱和。仅基于最终答案正确性的稀疏奖励无法评估解剖学依据或临床逻辑，从而通过答案捷径诱发奖励黑客（reward hacking）。我们提出 MedCBR，一个两阶段对齐框架，将边界感知偏好优化与基于评分细则的强化学习相结合。首先，我们利用经验通过率和偏好对，在模型能力前沿构建反事实边界偏好，这些偏好对共享推理前缀但在决定性诊断分支处发生分歧。难度加权边界偏好优化（Difficulty Weighted Boundary Preference Optimization, DBPO）将学习集中在经过校准的边界区域。其次，我们从边界轨迹中提炼可复用的临床评分细则，并根据预测熵激活它们。熵门控有依据策略优化（Entropy Gated Grounded Policy Optimization, EGPO）奖励答案正确性、解剖学依据和推理保真度，同时在可靠样本上抑制评分细则噪声。一个锚定到边界对齐模型的参考策略将群体级边界先验与实例级不确定性耦合，使诊断推理更准确且更具临床依据。在六个医学基准上的实验显示，相对于强通用、专用和强化学习基线均有持续改进，达到 61.2% 的平均准确率，在具有挑战性的鉴别诊断任务上增益最大。消融实验显示出超加性增益：将两个阶段结合所取得的改进超过二者各自改进之和。

title: What Makes Medical Examination Items Difficult? Using Large Language Models to Explore Patterns Associated With Empirical Item Difficulty
zh_title: 用大语言模型探索医学考试题目难度规律
summary: 以 USMLE 与 PANCE 实测难度标签引导大模型归纳难度评分规则，并检验规则对难度判断的影响。
key_points: 用实测难度标签让大模型归纳可解释的难度规则
分别构建绝对难度与成对比较难度两套规则
线索汇聚、误导线索与选项竞争被视为主要难度来源
预印本，未经同行评审
reason: 大模型用于医学教育评价的新颖分析，预印本且无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Research on medical item difficulty has largely focused on prediction rather than on identifying interpretable patterns associated with empirical difficulty. This study used empirical difficulty labels to guide large language models (LLMs) in inducing difficulty rubrics and examined how rubric guidance affected LLM difficulty judgments. Using training items and their empirical difficulty estimates from the United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE) and the Physician Assistant National Certifying Examination (PANCE), Claude Opus 5 induced separate rubrics for absolute and pairwise difficulty judgment. None of the induced rubrics treated surface features, such as stem length, option count, or images, as major sources of difficulty. Several patterns emerged across both examinations, including cue convergence, misleading cues, and option competition, although their specific forms differed. Retrieval of knowledge that could not be derived from the stem was particularly prominent in the PANCE rubrics, whereas the USMLE rubrics placed greater emphasis on integrating multiple clinical cues. We compared commercial and open-weight LLMs on held-out items under unguided and rubric-guided conditions. Rubric guidance changed how models used the difficulty scale but did not consistently improve performance. In absolute judgments, guidance encouraged broader use of the scale and generally improved coarse-grained agreement, without consistently improving rank ordering. In pairwise comparisons, its effects varied across models and examinations, and judgments became more sensitive to presentation order. These findings suggest that the value of label-guided rubric induction may lie more in generating interpretable, testable hypotheses from empirical difficulty data than in reliably improving difficulty judgments.
zh_abstract: 关于医学题目难度的研究在很大程度上集中于预测，而不是识别与经验难度相关的可解释模式。本研究使用经验难度标签引导大语言模型（large language models, LLMs）归纳难度评分细则，并考察评分细则引导如何影响 LLM 的难度判断。利用美国医师执照考试（United States Medical Licensing Examination, USMLE）和医师助理全国认证考试（Physician Assistant National Certifying Examination, PANCE）的训练题目及其经验难度估计，Claude Opus 5 分别为绝对难度判断和成对难度判断归纳了独立的评分细则。所归纳的评分细则均未将表面特征（如题干长度、选项数量或图像）视为难度的主要来源。两项考试中都出现了若干模式，包括线索汇聚、误导性线索和选项竞争，尽管其具体形式有所不同。检索无法从题干中推导出的知识在 PANCE 评分细则中尤为突出，而 USMLE 评分细则更强调整合多个临床线索。我们在未引导和评分细则引导条件下，在留出题目上比较了商业和开放权重 LLM。评分细则引导改变了模型使用难度量表的方式，但未持续提升表现。在绝对判断中，引导鼓励更广泛地使用量表，并总体上改善了粗粒度一致性，但未持续改善排序。在成对比较中，其效果因模型和考试而异，且判断对呈现顺序变得更加敏感。这些发现表明，标签引导的评分细则归纳的价值可能更多在于从经验难度数据中生成可解释、可检验的假设，而不是可靠地改善难度判断。

title: When Should AI Decide, Defer, and Deviate? Responsible Automation for Deceased Donor Kidney Allocation
zh_title: AI何时决策、转交或偏离：遗体供肾分配
summary: 以遗体供肾分配为例，提出一个框架来界定 AI 何时可建议决策、何时应转交人类专家、何时偏离既往做法。
key_points: 历史决策记录的是曾做过什么而非应做什么
数据稀疏处模型不确定性过高不宜直接行动
约30%回收的遗体供肾从未被移植
AI 可标记延迟或失败放置风险以支持序外分配
预印本，未经同行评审
reason: 涉及分配公平与人类监督的治理框架，但为预印本案例研究，属值得一看档
abstract: We ask when an AI trained on historical decisions should be allowed to recommend decisions, defer to human experts, or in other cases, flag concerning patterns in data and deviate from past practice. This can be challenging because past decisions record what was done rather than what should have been done, and where data is sparse, a model's predictions may be too uncertain to act on. We provide a framework for addressing this problem using a case study in deceased-donor kidney allocation. Nearly 30% of kidneys recovered from deceased donors in the United States are never transplanted, largely because they are hard to place through the standard waitlist sequence. One can use AI to flag kidneys at risk of delayed or failed placement for out-of-sequence (OOS) allocation, but this comes at the cost of bypassing candidates higher on the waitlist. Thus, OOS allocation should only be used when the organ is demonstrably at high risk of discard on the standard sequence. Using Organ Procurement and Transplantation Network match-run data from 2016-2019 and 2023-2025 (excluding COVID-19-disrupted years), we build the Arbitrator framework, which combines various interpretable models and acts only when the uncertainty in their predictions cannot change the preferred action. Our Arbitrator resolves 93.5% of organ placement decisions using explicit medical criteria learned from data, and defers the remaining 6.5% to a human or a more complex model. We show that the Arbitrator correctly identifies 70.1% of historically discarded low-KDPI kidneys as OOS candidates, projecting that up to 43.9% of historically discarded kidneys could be flagged for expedited placement and potentially transplanted. We then exploit the interpretability of the Arbitrator to create an agentic audit comparing the learned rules to published clinical literature in order to flag decision-making patterns that are contentious.
zh_abstract: 我们提出：当人工智能基于历史决策训练时，应在何时被允许推荐决策、听从人类专家，或在其他情况下标记数据中令人担忧的模式并偏离既往实践。这一问题可能具有挑战性，因为历史决策记录的是曾经做了什么，而不是本应做什么；并且在数据稀疏之处，模型的预测可能过于不确定而无法据此行动。我们通过 deceased-donor kidney allocation（死亡供者肾分配）的案例研究，提供一个解决该问题的框架。在美国，从死亡供者获取的肾脏中近30%从未被移植，主要原因是它们难以通过标准等待名单顺序进行放置。可以使用人工智能标记存在延迟或放置失败风险的肾脏，以进行 out-of-sequence（OOS，顺序外）分配，但这以绕过等待名单上更靠前的候选者为代价。因此，只有当器官在标准顺序下明显存在高弃用风险时，才应使用 OOS 分配。使用 Organ Procurement and Transplantation Network（器官获取与移植网络）2016-2019年和2023-2025年的 match-run 数据（排除受 COVID-19 干扰的年份），我们构建了 Arbitrator 框架，该框架结合多种可解释模型，并且仅在其预测中的不确定性无法改变首选行动时才采取行动。我们的 Arbitrator 使用从数据中学习到的明确医学标准，解决了93.5%的器官放置决策，并将其余6.5%交由人类或更复杂的模型处理。我们表明，Arbitrator 正确地将历史上被弃用的低 KDPI 肾脏中的70.1%识别为 OOS 候选者，并预测高达43.9%的历史上被弃用肾脏可被标记为加快放置并有可能被移植。随后，我们利用 Arbitrator 的可解释性创建 agentic audit（智能体审计），将学到的规则与已发表的临床文献进行比较，以标记有争议的决策模式。

title: Guidance-Coupled Nullspace Drifting for One-Step Medical Image Reconstruction
zh_title: 面向一步医学图像重建的引导耦合零空间漂移方法
summary: 提出 DriftRecon，在成像算子零空间内做漂移建模，实现医学图像一步生成式重建。
key_points: 在成像算子零空间内构造训练噪声与漂移
把渐进式细化移到训练阶段，支持一步采样
针对迭代采样推理成本高的问题
reason: 预印本新方法，思路有新意但证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Generative reconstruction can recover high-quality images from undersampled acquisitions, but state-of-the-art generative priors commonly rely on iterative sampling. Reducing the number of iterations lowers inference cost but also removes opportunities for progressive distributional refinement, making it difficult to retain image realism without sacrificing reconstruction fidelity. Drift modeling offers an alternative by shifting progressive refinement to training, thereby enabling one-step sampling without an iterative inference trajectory. Existing drifting methods, however, do not account for the imaging operator when modeling distributional drift. We propose DriftRecon, a generative method for one-step medical image reconstruction that performs drifting directly in the nullspace of the imaging operator. DriftRecon uses nullspace-restricted noise to construct training samples and a multiscale generator that incorporates measurement conditioning across resolution levels, with its generated component projected onto the operator nullspace. To control the fidelity--realism trade-off at inference, a conditional guidance parameter continuously steers the same generator between measurement-conditioned and unconditional generation. We derive a guidance-dependent similarity-kernel temperature schedule that preserves the guidance-weighted mass receiving strengthened supervision, thereby progressively localizing drift interactions as guidance increases to limit the associated loss of reconstruction fidelity. Experiments in sparse-view CT and accelerated MRI reconstruction show that DriftRecon outperforms established generative reconstruction methods and recent drifting models while producing reconstructions in a single forward pass.
zh_abstract: 生成式重建可从欠采样采集中恢复高质量图像，但最先进的生成式先验通常依赖迭代采样。减少迭代次数会降低推理成本，但也会消除渐进式分布细化的机会，使得在不牺牲重建保真度的情况下难以保持图像真实感。漂移建模（drift modeling）通过将渐进式细化转移到训练阶段提供了另一种选择，从而无需迭代推理轨迹即可实现一步采样。然而，现有的漂移方法在建模分布漂移时未考虑成像算子。我们提出 DriftRecon，这是一种用于一步医学图像重建的生成式方法，直接在成像算子的零空间中进行漂移。DriftRecon 使用零空间受限噪声构建训练样本，并使用多尺度生成器在多个分辨率层级纳入测量条件化，其生成分量被投影到算子零空间上。为在推理时控制保真度-真实感权衡，一个条件引导参数持续引导同一生成器在测量条件生成与无条件生成之间切换。我们推导出一个依赖引导的相似性核温度调度，该调度保留接受强化监督的引导加权质量，从而随着引导增强逐步局部化漂移交互，以限制相关的重建保真度损失。稀疏视角 CT 和加速 MRI 重建实验表明，DriftRecon 在单次前向传播中产生重建的同时，优于既有的生成式重建方法和近期的漂移模型。

title: D-MOD: Diffusion mode estimation for accelerated MRI
zh_title: D-MOD：加速MRI的扩散模型后验众数估计
summary: 提出D-MOD，用扩散模型求后验众数，替代需多次采样的后验采样以加速MRI重建。
key_points: 对平滑对数后验下界做minorize-maximize迭代
每步采样去噪后经共轭梯度解融合k空间
在fastMRI脑部T1/T2/FLAIR上验证
reason: 公开数据集上的预印本重建方法，有新意但缺外部验证
abstract: Diffusion models are powerful priors for accelerated MRI reconstruction, but most current methods are posterior samplers, which return a random draw from the posterior. A reproducible and high-quality reconstruction often requires averaging many samples, resulting in a high computational cost. We introduce D-MOD, a fast algorithm that instead provides a posterior mode. It uses a minorize-maximize algorithm on a lower bound of the smoothed log-posterior, which provably increases the objective. Each iteration draws S noisy samples of the current estimate at the current noise level, denoises them with a pretrained diffusion model, and combines their average with the measured k-space through a conjugate-gradient (CG) solve. We anneal the noise levels, as the distance between the bound and its target decays quadratically with noise. On fastMRI brain (T1, T2, FLAIR), a single D-MOD reconstruction exceeds, in PSNR, the 10-sample finite-MMSE estimates of DPS, DAPS and SNORE-P and stays within 0.31 dB of the strongest baselines (DiffPIR, DDS). This approach thus provides a fast deterministic reconstruction algorithm (11-73 times faster than MMSE estimates), which is useful in a clinical setting.
zh_abstract: 扩散模型是加速MRI重建的强大先验，但当前大多数方法是后验采样器，返回从后验中的随机抽样。可重复且高质量的重建通常需要对许多样本取平均，导致高计算成本。我们提出D-MOD，一种快速算法，转而提供后验众数。它在平滑对数后验的下界上使用minorize-maximize算法，可证明提升目标函数。每次迭代在当前噪声水平下抽取当前估计的S个含噪样本，用预训练扩散模型对其去噪，并通过共轭梯度（CG）求解将其平均值与测得的k空间结合。我们对噪声水平进行退火，因为下界与其目标之间的距离随噪声二次衰减。在fastMRI脑（T1、T2、FLAIR）上，单次D-MOD重建的PSNR超过DPS、DAPS和SNORE-P的10样本有限MMSE估计，并与最强基线（DiffPIR、DDS）相差不超过0.31 dB。因此，该方法提供了一种快速确定性重建算法（比MMSE估计快11–73倍），在临床环境中有用。

title: Annotation-Free Representation Learning for Polyp Retrieval in Colonoscopy Videos

summary: 提出无需边界框标注的框架，从原始结肠镜视频自监督学习息肉轨迹表征并做检索。

在 REAL-Colon 上轨迹检索与重识别优于基线

abstract: Colonoscopy is inherently comparative: reliable visual assessment of polyps often depends on complementary views acquired under different viewpoints and imaging conditions. Retrieving such views requires polyp tracklet representations, which recent contrastive methods learn from temporal cues but still build from manually annotated bounding boxes. We propose an annotation-free framework that constructs tracklet views directly from raw colonoscopy videos, enabling temporal self-supervised learning on full-procedure videos, including frames without visible polyps. On REAL-Colon, our method achieves state-of-the-art results on tracklet retrieval and re-identification, outperforming both self-supervised and supervised baselines. We then introduce few-shot polyp retrieval, a task closer to clinical use, where a few observations of a target polyp are used to retrieve its remaining tracklets: with only two examples, our method surpasses most competing methods given ten. Finally, we show that a modest number of unlabeled procedures suffices for competitive performance, making on-site model development more practical. Code is available at https://github.com/lparolari/freerep.
zh_abstract: 结肠镜检查本质上是比较性的：对息肉进行可靠的视觉评估，往往依赖于在不同视角和成像条件下采集的互补视图。检索此类视图需要息肉轨迹片段（tracklet）表征；近期的对比学习方法从时间线索中学习这种表征，但仍基于人工标注的边界框构建。我们提出一个无需标注的框架，直接从原始结肠镜视频构建轨迹片段视图，从而能够在完整操作视频（包括无可见息肉的帧）上进行时间自监督学习。在 REAL-Colon 上，我们的方法在轨迹片段检索和重识别方面取得最先进的结果，优于自监督和监督基线。随后我们引入少样本息肉检索，这一任务更接近临床使用：利用目标息肉的少量观测来检索其剩余轨迹片段；仅用两个示例，我们的方法就超过了大多数在给定十个示例时的竞争方法。最后，我们表明少量未标注操作视频足以获得有竞争力的性能，使现场模型开发更加实用。代码见 https://github.com/lparolari/freerep。

title: Exploring tinnitus-like central hyperactivity in a large language model-based computational analog of hearing loss.

abstract: [Hearing research] Tinnitus is commonly associated with maladaptive neural plasticity following hearing loss. Although large language models (LLMs) share similarities with the human brain in language processing and representation, their potential for modeling tinnitus-related neural mechanisms remains limited. This study aimed to develop an LLM-based framework to investigate tinnitus-related maladaptive neural plasticity. An LLM was partitioned into eight independently trainable regions. An exploratory computational analogy of deafferentation-related changes associated with peripheral hearing loss was developed by applying token-specific high-frequency attenuation during training on a commonsense reasoning task. Region-specific contributions to tinnitus-like excess activity were quantified using region-wise plasticity ablation, selectively disabling plasticity in one region at a time. Representational relationships among regions were evaluated using centered kernel alignment. The computational deafferentation analog largely preserved task accuracy but showed increased activity. Region 1 was the only region with a net suppressive contribution to excess activity, whereas region 2 exhibited the largest positive contribution; regions 6 and 8 also contributed positively. Regions 1 and 2 remained representationally distinct across all conditions. Deafferentation tended to reduce region 1-region 2 similarity, whereas plasticity ablation in most regions, except for regions 6 and 8, tended to increase it. The proposed LLM-based framework captured network-level functional dissociations consistent with current theories of hearing loss-associated tinnitus, identifying distinct suppressive, transformation, and higher-order modulatory roles. These findings highlight the potential of LLMs to investigate maladaptive neural changes underlying tinnitus. This framework may provide the foundation for constructing patient-specific digital twins.
zh_abstract: ［Hearing research］耳鸣通常与听力损失后适应不良的神经可塑性相关。尽管大语言模型（LLMs）在语言处理和表征方面与人脑具有相似性，但其用于建模耳鸣相关神经机制的潜力仍然有限。本研究旨在开发一个基于LLM的框架，以研究耳鸣相关的适应不良神经可塑性。将一个LLM划分为八个可独立训练的区域。通过在常识推理任务训练期间施加词元特异性的高频衰减，开发了一个与外周性听力损失相关的去传入相关变化的探索性计算类比。使用区域特异性可塑性消融来量化各区域对耳鸣样过度活动的贡献，每次选择性地禁用一个区域的可塑性。使用中心核对齐评估区域之间的表征关系。计算性去传入类比在很大程度上保持了任务准确性，但显示出活动增加。区域1是唯一对过度活动具有净抑制贡献的区域，而区域2表现出最大的正贡献；区域6和8也有正贡献。在所有条件下，区域1和区域2在表征上保持不同。去传入倾向于降低区域1与区域2的相似性，而除区域6和8外，大多数区域的可塑性消融倾向于增加该相似性。所提出的基于LLM的框架捕捉到了与当前听力损失相关耳鸣理论一致的网络层面功能分离，识别出不同的抑制性、转换性和高阶调制作用。这些发现凸显了LLMs在研究耳鸣背后适应不良神经变化方面的潜力。该框架可能为构建患者特异性数字孪生提供基础。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Ankara University; conditions: Peri-implantitis, Alveolar Bone Loss, Dental Implant; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 784; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Dental implants are a routine treatment for missing teeth, but the number of implants affected by peri-implantitis, a progressive inflammatory disease of the tissues around implants, is increasing. The main radiographic sign of peri-implantitis is marginal bone loss around the implant. Early detection and correct grading of this bone loss in proportion to implant length are important for treatment planning and prognosis. Panoramic radiographs are widely used for general screening in dental practice, but judging bone loss on them is subjective, time-consuming and depends on the clinician's experience. Multimodal large language models (vision-language models) are increasingly able to interpret images, yet their ability to evaluate peri-implant bone loss on panoramic radiographs has not been tested. This single-center, retrospective, observational diagnostic accuracy study will evaluate how accurately five publicly available large language models (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, DeepSeek and Grok) detect and grade peri-implant marginal bone loss on anonymized, cropped panoramic radiographs of functionally loaded dental implants, compared with a reference standard established by three blinded clinicians (two periodontologists and one oral and maxillofacial radiologist). Bone loss will be graded with the Froum and Rosen (2012) classification: Score 0 (no visible bone loss), Score 1 (\ 50%). Approximately 784 implant sites (392 with and 392 without marginal bone loss) from existing panoramic radiographs in the hospital archive will be included. No new radiographs will be taken, no patient will be contacted and no treatment will be given; informed consent has been waived by the ethics committee. All images will be fully anonymized before evaluation.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：安卡拉大学；疾病：种植体周围炎、牙槽骨丧失、牙种植体；类型：OBSERVATIONAL；入组：784；状态：NOT_YET_RECRUITING] 牙种植体是缺牙的常规治疗方法，但受种植体周围炎（一种种植体周围组织的进行性炎症性疾病）影响的种植体数量正在增加。种植体周围炎的主要影像学征象是种植体周围的边缘骨丧失。早期发现并按种植体长度比例正确分级这种骨丧失对于治疗计划和预后很重要。全景X线片在牙科实践中广泛用于一般筛查，但根据其判断骨丧失是主观的、耗时的，并且取决于临床医生的经验。多模态大语言模型（视觉-语言模型）越来越能够解读图像，但其评估全景X线片上种植体周围骨丧失的能力尚未得到测试。这项单中心、回顾性、观察性诊断准确性研究将评估五种公开可用的大语言模型（ChatGPT、Gemini、Claude、DeepSeek 和 Grok）在功能负载牙种植体的匿名裁剪全景X线片上检测和分级种植体周围边缘骨丧失的准确性，并与由三名盲法临床医生（两名牙周病学家和一名口腔颌面放射科医生）建立的参考标准进行比较。骨丧失将采用 Froum 和 Rosen（2012）分类进行分级：Score 0（无可见骨丧失），Score 1（\ 50%）。将纳入医院档案中现有全景X线片的约784个种植位点（392个有边缘骨丧失，392个无边缘骨丧失）。不会拍摄新的X线片，不会联系患者，也不会给予治疗；伦理委员会已豁免知情同意。所有图像在评估前将完全匿名化。

abstract: [Microorganisms] The escalating crisis of invasive fungal infections and increasing antifungal resistance demand rapid therapeutic innovation. Given the critically narrow clinical arsenal, artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) have emerged as pivotal strategies to accelerate drug repurposing, providing a rapid alternative to de novo drug discovery. However, translational success in medical mycology faces a major biological hurdle: the "eukaryotic paradox," the extensive genomic, metabolic, and structural homology between fungal cells and human hosts. This review provides a critical and comparative analysis of AI-driven drug repurposing as a therapeutic strategy. This review characterizes the hierarchies of structural barriers, biophysical transport bottlenecks, and computational failure modes across bacterial, viral, and fungal pathogens to explain why medical mycology remains one of the most difficult frontiers in computational pharmacology. It reviews limitations of fungal cell walls, biofilm EPS matrices, morphologic dynamic dimorphism, and scarcity of high-resolution 3D protein structures for AI models. Next-generation computational approaches and experimental platforms, ranging from physics-informed neural networks and transcriptomic profiling to microfluidic organ-on-a-chip validation systems, are also described to overcome these resistance mechanisms. Finally, this review emphasizes the importance of the development of tailored, physics-informed AI paradigms for effective therapeutic strategies against emerging resistant fungal pathogens.
zh_abstract: 【微生物】侵袭性真菌感染危机不断升级以及抗真菌耐药性日益增加，要求快速的治疗创新。鉴于临床可用手段极其有限，人工智能（AI）和机器学习（ML）已成为加速药物重定位的关键策略，为从头药物发现提供了快速替代方案。然而，医学真菌学的转化成功面临一个重大生物学障碍：“真核生物悖论”，即真菌细胞与人类宿主之间存在广泛的基因组、代谢和结构同源性。本综述对AI驱动的药物重定位作为一种治疗策略进行了批判性和比较性分析。本综述刻画了细菌、病毒和真菌病原体中的结构屏障层级、生物物理运输瓶颈和计算失败模式，以解释为何医学真菌学仍是计算药理学中最困难的前沿之一。它综述了真菌细胞壁、生物膜胞外聚合物（EPS）基质、形态动态二形性以及AI模型缺乏高分辨率3D蛋白质结构等局限性。还描述了下一代计算方法和实验平台，从物理信息神经网络和转录组分析到微流控器官芯片验证系统，以克服这些耐药机制。最后，本综述强调开发量身定制的、物理信息驱动的AI范式对于针对新出现的耐药真菌病原体制定有效治疗策略的重要性。

abstract: [Sensors (Basel, Switzerland)] Ischemic heart disease is the leading cause of global mortality, yet accurate and timely detection remains constrained by incomplete signal capture, noise, operator dependence, and imperfect reference standards. Artificial intelligence (AI) may enhance cardiovascular sensing by extracting latent diagnostic information from routinely acquired signals. This narrative review examines AI-enabled approaches to ischemia detection across three sensing modalities: the electrocardiogram as a bioelectric sensor, cardiac troponin as a biochemical marker, and cardiac imaging technologies (echocardiography, computed tomography, magnetic resonance, and nuclear imaging) as structural and functional sensors. For each modality, we evaluate the sensing pipeline, the reference standards, the endpoint actually measured (from acute coronary occlusion to functional ischemia), and reported performance metrics, separating diagnostic accuracy from effects on clinical workflow, patient outcomes, and cost. We also discuss emerging directions, including foundation models and multimodal fusion, together with translational challenges such as limited prospective validation, regulatory hurdles, and uncertain cost-effectiveness. Most evidence comes from retrospective, frequently single-center studies of diagnostic performance; few studies have measured effects on workflow, and fewer still on patient outcomes or cost. Routine clinical adoption will require prospective multicenter trials, standardized performance benchmarks, and evidence of clinical and economic benefit.

abstract: [Journal of applied clinical medical physics] Workforce shortages and increasing clinical demands in Radiation Oncology and Medical Physics present challenges for maintaining high-quality residency training. This work presents a conceptual framework to evaluate the potential role of artificial intelligence (AI) in improving efficiency, scalability, and quality of residency education. Current teaching and learning modalities were categorized, and their relative contributions to training were estimated. Potential AI applications were mapped to these modalities, and the proportion of training that could be supported by AI was assessed. A simple conceptual model incorporating training time, AI-deliverable components (i.e., those potentially supported through direct interaction with AI systems), and dependence on direct human teaching was used to illustrate the potential impact on instructional effort. The potential effect of AI on educational quality was qualitatively evaluated, as well as limitations of AI for routine educational integration. AI applications were identified across multiple domains, including workflow-integrated feedback, simulation-based training, adaptive learning, and automated assessment. The largest potential impact was estimated in workflow-integrated, simulation-based, and self-directed learning environments. While reductions in direct human teaching effort were estimated to be modest, AI-enabled approaches were estimated to achieve substantial improvements in training quality, including increased feedback frequency, enhanced support for deliberate practice, and greater exposure to rare or high-risk scenarios. AI has the potential to enhance residency training by improving consistency, scalability, and educational quality. In the context of workforce constraints, the primary benefit of AI may be to augment training efficiency and reduce reliance on limited faculty resources while preserving the essential role of clinical experience.

abstract: O-GlcNAc transferase (OGT) is an essential glycosyltransferase that regulates cellular processes through the addition of O-linked {beta}-N-acetyglucosamine (O-GlcNAc) to target proteins. Substrate recognition and protein-protein interactions are mediated by the tetratricopeptide repeat (TPR) domain, yet the contributions of individual TPR repeats to structural stability and function remain poorly understood. Here, we employed an integrated computational framework combining an AI protein co-scientist, Speak to a Protein, which incorporates Boltz-2 for structure prediction and rDock for ligand binding evaluation, with external tools including AlphaFold3 for more advanced structure prediction and the HDOCK server for protein-protein docking. This framework was used to investigate how deletions of TPR domains and disease-associated amino acid substitutions within the TPR domain affect OGT structure and function. Five synthetic truncation OGT isoforms, thirteen single-TPR deletion variants, and five X-linked intellectual disability (XLID)-associated amino acid substitutions were modeled and aligned to wild-type OGT for comparison. Structural perturbations were quantified using backbone root mean square deviation (RMSD), while functional effects were assessed through docking analyses with UDP-GlcNAc, Host Cell Factor 1 (HCF1), and Tet methylcytosine dioxygenase 1 (TET1). Variation in TPR length altered global protein structure and induced long-range conformational changes within the catalytic domain despite no sequence modifications in that region. Single TPR deletions showed that individual repeats contribute unequally to structural stability, with deletions in mid-to-late TPR domains producing the largest structural disruptions. Disease-associated amino acid substitutions also generated conformational changes and reduced predicted ligand binding, consistent with known reductions in enzymatic activity in XLID. Protein-protein docking analyses demonstrated substrate-specific effects, as domain deletion and amino acid substitution variants of OGT had different interactions with TET1 and HCF1. Collectively, these findings identify the TPR domain as a regulatory domain that governs structure, ligand recognition, and protein interactions. zh_abstract: O-GlcNAc转移酶（O-GlcNAc transferase, OGT）是一种必需的糖基转移酶，通过将O-连接的β-N-乙酰葡糖胺（O-GlcNAc）添加到靶蛋白上调控细胞过程。底物识别和蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用由四肽重复（tetratricopeptide repeat, TPR）结构域介导，但单个TPR重复序列对结构稳定性和功能的贡献仍知之甚少。在此，我们采用了一个整合计算框架，将AI蛋白质协同科学家“Speak to a Protein”（其整合了用于结构预测的Boltz-2和用于配体结合评估的rDock）与外部工具（包括用于更高级结构预测的AlphaFold3和用于蛋白质-蛋白质对接的HDOCK服务器）相结合。该框架用于研究TPR结构域的缺失以及TPR结构域内疾病相关氨基酸替换如何影响OGT的结构和功能。我们对5种合成截短型OGT亚型、13种单个TPR缺失变异体和5种X连锁智力障碍（X-linked intellectual disability, XLID）相关氨基酸替换进行了建模，并与野生型OGT比对以进行比较。结构扰动使用主链均方根偏差（root mean square deviation, RMSD）量化，功能效应则通过与UDP-GlcNAc、宿主细胞因子1（Host Cell Factor 1, HCF1）和Tet甲基胞嘧啶双加氧酶1（Tet methylcytosine dioxygenase 1, TET1）的对接分析进行评估。TPR长度的变化改变了整体蛋白质结构，并在催化结构域内诱导了长程构象变化，尽管该区域没有序列修饰。单个TPR缺失显示，各个重复序列对结构稳定性的贡献不相等，TPR结构域中后段的缺失产生最大的结构破坏。疾病相关氨基酸替换也产生了构象变化并降低了预测的配体结合，这与XLID中已知的酶活性降低一致。蛋白质-蛋白质对接分析显示了底物特异性效应，因为OGT的结构域缺失和氨基酸替换变异体与TET1和HCF1具有不同的相互作用。总之，这些发现将TPR结构域确定为一个调控结构域，调控结构、配体识别和蛋白质相互作用。更广泛地说，这项工作证明了将蛋白质协同科学家与蛋白质结构建模工具相结合，可用于预测结构域缺失或自然氨基酸变异的结构和功能后果。

abstract: Background. Sequence-to-contact-map models are trained with pixel-wise losses, although the features of interest (insulation, domain boundaries, loops) are summaries of the map. Insulationbased losses help Hi-C resolution enhancement. No pre-specified test has asked whether they improve sequence-based prediction, judged against annotations independent of the training data. Proposed study. HiFold-Mamba predicts 448 x 448 maps at 2,048 bp from 1,048,576 bp of DNA on the DNALongBench contact-map task. Every component is reverse-complement-equivariant: convolutional tower, bidirectional Mamba blocks, multi-scale mixer and symmetric pairwise head. We pre-register three hypotheses: >> H1: it exceeds each of three trained baselines (reproduced Akita, a parameter-matched Transformer and a parameter-matched CNN) by [≥]0.01 stratum-adjusted correlation (SCC). >> H2: an insulation and boundary loss, computed from the predicted map with the operator used on the observed map, improves boundary AUROC and loop AP against independent 4DN boundary calls and ENCODE CTCF ChIA-PET loops, at equal training steps and without loss of SCC. >> H3: pretraining plus few-shot adaptation beats training from scratch on four held-out cell lines.Tests use a paired bootstrap over 237 one-megabase test blocks (one-sided = 0.025). Pilot data. >> Verification. The benchmark target, the window coordinates and the networks equivariance were verified. >> Locus-shared reference. Copying other cell lines measured maps at the same locus matches published Akita on the benchmarks SCC (0.227 vs. 0.230). >> SCC weightings. Two weightings in common use weight distance strata in opposite directions and agree only moderately ({rho} = 0.54). >> Comparison rule. In simulations calibrated on the pilot data, a per-block-best comparison against several baselines has no power. We therefore test against each baseline, which gives [≥] 90 % power at a true gain of 0.02 when between-model correlation is [≥] 0.95. >> H2 positive control. On validation windows, observed maps recover the independent boundaries (AUROC 0.61 - 0.91) and loops (0.86 - 0.90). This fixed the insulation window and showed that these annotations are largely shared across cell types.
zh_abstract: 【背景】序列到接触图谱模型使用逐像素损失训练，尽管感兴趣的特征（绝缘、结构域边界、环）是图谱的概要。基于绝缘的损失有助于Hi-C分辨率增强。尚无预先指定的检验询问它们是否能改善基于序列的预测，并以独立于训练数据的注释进行判断。【拟议研究】HiFold-Mamba在DNALongBench接触图谱任务上，从1,048,576 bp的DNA预测2,048 bp分辨率的448 x 448图谱。每个组件都具有反向互补等变性：卷积塔、双向Mamba块、多尺度混合器和对称成对头。我们预先注册三个假设：>> H1：它超过三个训练基线（复现的Akita、参数匹配的Transformer和参数匹配的CNN）中的每一个，至少提高[≥]0.01的层校正相关性（SCC）。>> H2：使用与观察图谱相同算子从预测图谱计算的绝缘和边界损失，在相同训练步数且不损失SCC的情况下，相对于独立的4DN边界调用和ENCODE CTCF ChIA-PET环，改善边界AUROC和环AP。>> H3：预训练加少样本适应在四个留出细胞系上优于从头训练。检验使用对237个一兆碱基测试块的配对bootstrap（单侧=0.025）。【预试验数据】>> 验证。基准目标、窗口坐标和网络等变性已验证。>> 位点共享参考。复制其他细胞系在同一基因座测量的图谱，在基准SCC上与已发表的Akita匹配（0.227 vs. 0.230）。>> SCC加权。两种常用加权以相反方向对距离分层加权，仅中等程度一致（{rho} = 0.54）。>> 比较规则。在根据预试验数据校准的模拟中，针对多个基线的逐块最佳比较没有检验效能。因此我们针对每个基线进行检验，当模型间相关性[≥] 0.95时，在真实增益为0.02时给出[≥] 90 %的效能。>> H2阳性对照。在验证窗口上，观察图谱恢复独立边界（AUROC 0.61 - 0.91）和环（0.86 - 0.90）。这固定了绝缘窗口，并表明这些注释在细胞类型之间很大程度上共享。

abstract: In real-world clinical settings, dental X-ray segmentation using deep learning methods suffers from reliability issues. Even when the segmentation quality is bad, deep learning models show high confidence in their predictions (calibrational blindness). Moreover, in real use, doctors do not have ground-truth masks to check their accuracy. To address this problem, we introduce a simple quality-checking engine called HUS-QA with three stages. We train it on the PRAD (Periapical Dental X-ray) dataset to build our SimCLR self-supervised ResNet-18 U-Net model, which generates the segmentation mask and then evaluates its quality. Our HUS-QA checks the segmentation mask quality without a ground-truth mask. Prediction confidence, edge sharpness, shape connectivity, and area-size penalty are the simple indicators considered in this research. Results show that standard confidence methods fail (r = -0.1394, p = 1.7864e-3, ROC AUC = 0.4275). By contrast, our HUS-QA shows a positive correlation with actual Dice scores (r = 0.4647, p = 3.7510e-28) and achieves a strong ROC-AUC of 0.8405. Therefore, HUS-QA serves as a practical tool for clinical quality control.
zh_abstract: 在真实临床环境中，使用深度学习方法进行牙科 X 射线分割存在可靠性问题。即使分割质量很差，深度学习模型也对其预测表现出高置信度（校准盲区，calibrational blindness）。此外，在实际使用中，医生没有真实标注掩膜（ground-truth masks）来检查其准确性。为解决这一问题，我们引入一个简单的质量检查引擎，称为 HUS-QA，包含三个阶段。我们在 PRAD（根尖牙科 X 射线，Periapical Dental X-ray）数据集上训练它，以构建我们的 SimCLR 自监督 ResNet-18 U-Net 模型；该模型生成分割掩膜，然后评估其质量。我们的 HUS-QA 在没有真实标注掩膜的情况下检查分割掩膜质量。预测置信度、边缘锐度、形状连通性和面积大小惩罚是本研究中考虑的简单指标。结果表明，标准置信度方法失败（r = -0.1394，p = 1.7864e-3，ROC AUC = 0.4275）。相比之下，我们的 HUS-QA 与实际 Dice 分数呈正相关（r = 0.4647，p = 3.7510e-28），并达到 0.8405 的强 ROC-AUC。因此，HUS-QA 可作为临床质量控制的实用工具。

title: Rural Readiness: Domain Generalization with Adversarially Chosen Domains

key_points: 以数据丰富医院知识支持农村临床算法

abstract: Predictive models trained at well-resourced data-rich institutions often fail when deployed in new populations. Motivated by the goal of building clinical diagnosis and decision-making algorithms for data-scarce rural populations using the general knowledge learned from data-rich hospitals, we formulate the fundamental question of \emph{domain generalization with adversarially chosen domains}, which asks a learner to perform on any unseen target domain nearly as well as the worst hypothesis consistent with the evidence from the observed source domains. Assuming only that the hypothesis class contains a "universal" predictor with small error on all $k$ source domains, we characterize the sample complexity of this objective up to logarithmic factors. Letting $d$ denote the VC dimension of the hypothesis class, we find, somewhat surprisingly, that the sample complexity reduces significantly from $Ω(dk)$ to $O(d)$ under a small relaxation of the learning goal in which, roughly speaking, we allow the learned model to compete with hypotheses that perform well on 99% instead of 100% of the source domains. By applying this insight to the meta-distributional setting, in which source domains are selected according to a distribution on distributions, we obtain a corresponding improvement over known sample complexity upper bounds. We also study the effect of data access to the target domain and show that a small labeled sample from the target domain does not improve the worst-case sample complexity on the source domains.
zh_abstract: 在资源充足、数据丰富的机构中训练的预测模型，在部署到新人群时常常失败。受目标驱动——利用从数据丰富医院学到的通用知识，为数据稀缺的农村人群构建临床诊断和决策算法——我们提出 domain generalization with adversarially chosen domains（对抗性选择域下的域泛化）这一基本问题，它要求学习器在任何未见目标域上的表现，几乎与和已观测源域证据一致的最差假设一样好。仅假设假设类包含一个在所有 $k$ 个源域上误差很小的“universal”（通用）预测器，我们在对数因子范围内刻画了该目标的样本复杂度。令 $d$ 表示假设类的 VC 维，我们有些意外地发现，在学习目标的小幅放松下——粗略地说，我们允许学习到的模型与在 99% 而非 100% 源域上表现良好的假设竞争——样本复杂度从 $Ω(dk)$ 显著降低到 $O(d)$。通过将这一洞见应用于元分布设置，即源域根据分布上的分布进行选择，我们相对于已知样本复杂度上界获得了相应改进。我们还研究了对目标域数据访问的影响，并表明来自目标域的小规模有标签样本不会改善源域上的最坏情况样本复杂度。

abstract: [Molecules (Basel, Switzerland)] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly being applied in clinical laboratories to support laboratory processes and interpretation of test results. Recent developments in machine learning, deep learning, and large language models have expanded the potential applications of AI across different stages of laboratory testing. However, the use of AI in clinical laboratories also raises important questions regarding validation, analytical performance, and transferability between laboratories. This narrative review examines recent applications of AI across the total testing process in clinical chemistry. Recent English-language scientific literature published from 2023 to 18 August 2026 was identified through searches of PubMed, Scopus, and Google Scholar. It describes AI-assisted test utilization; specimen handling and quality assessment; detection of laboratory errors; patient-based quality control; interpretation of complex analytical outputs, including signals from emerging AI-integrated biosensors and nanomaterial-based analytical platforms; result verification; and laboratory-report interpretation. The review also discusses major implementation challenges, including analytical variability, data quality, sensor and platform reproducibility, model generalizability, interoperability, and limitations of large language models. Particular attention is given to external validation, transportability, and real-world implementation. Among the studies considered in this review, many applications remain supported mainly by retrospective or internally validated studies, while prospective and operational evaluations are less common. Finally, practical considerations for validation, local verification, quality assurance, and performance monitoring are discussed. AI has considerable potential to support clinical chemistry laboratories, but safe use requires appropriate evaluation and continued involvement of laboratory professionals.
zh_abstract: [Molecules (Basel, Switzerland)] 人工智能（AI）越来越多地应用于临床实验室，以支持实验室流程和检验结果解读。机器学习、深度学习和大型语言模型的最新进展扩展了 AI 在检验不同阶段中的潜在应用。然而，AI 在临床实验室中的使用也提出了关于验证、分析性能以及实验室间可迁移性的重要问题。本叙述性综述考察了 AI 在临床化学全检验过程中的近期应用。通过检索 PubMed、Scopus 和 Google Scholar，识别出 2023 年至 2026 年 8 月 18 日发表的近期英文科学文献。本文描述了 AI 辅助的检验利用；标本处理和质量评估；实验室差错检测；基于患者的质控；复杂分析输出的解读，包括来自新兴 AI 集成生物传感器和基于纳米材料的分析平台的信号；结果审核；以及实验室报告解读。本综述还讨论了主要实施挑战，包括分析变异性、数据质量、传感器和平台可重复性、模型泛化性、互操作性以及大型语言模型的局限性。尤其关注外部验证、可迁移性和真实世界实施。在本综述考虑的研究中，许多应用仍主要得到回顾性或内部验证研究的支持，而前瞻性和运行性评价较少见。最后，讨论了验证、本地确认、质量保证和性能监测方面的实际考虑。AI 具有支持临床化学实验室的 considerable potential，但安全使用需要适当的评价以及实验室专业人员的持续参与。

abstract: Assessment of the main pancreatic duct (MPD) from volumetric magnetic resonance cholangiopancreatography (MRCP) scans is an essential task for ductal dilatation diagnosis and pancreatic cancer analysis. However, manual assessment is affected by reader variability in which automated analysis may assist. Nevertheless, fully automated and uncertainty-aware MPD analysis from volumetric MRCP remains underexplored area of research. In this study, we propose an automatic and uncertainty-aware deep learning-based pipeline for MPD segmentation and maximum-width analysis from MRCP scans. A coarse localisation model first identifies the ductal region-of-interest, followed by a fine model that segments the MPD within the region. The dataset consists of 256 MPD-segmented MRCP scans from 69 patients. A randomly selected holdout test subset of 14 patients with 55 MRCP volumes was used for evaluation. We employed a five-model cross-validation ensemble for improved performance and uncertainty estimation. The best MPD segmentation performance was 0.634 DSC, 0.744 precision, and 0.593 recall. The mean absolute error for maximum MPD width prediction was 0.355~mm and dilated MPD ($\geq 5$~mm) was detected with 75.0\% sensitivity and 74.4\% specificity. These novel results suggest that automated MPD segmentation can be used to aid MRCP-based duct measurements.
zh_abstract: 从容积磁共振胰胆管成像（MRCP）扫描评估主胰管（MPD）是胰管扩张诊断和胰腺癌分析的一项基本任务。然而，人工评估会受到阅片者变异的影响，而自动化分析可能对此提供帮助。尽管如此，从容积MRCP进行全自动且不确定性感知的MPD分析仍是一个研究不足的领域。在本研究中，我们提出了一种基于深度学习的自动且不确定性感知的流程，用于从MRCP扫描中进行MPD分割和最大宽度分析。首先由粗定位模型识别胰管感兴趣区，随后由精细模型在该区域内分割MPD。数据集由来自69例患者的256份MPD分割MRCP扫描组成。随机选取的14例患者、55份MRCP容积的留出测试子集用于评估。我们采用五模型交叉验证集成以提高性能并估计不确定性。最佳MPD分割性能为0.634 DSC、0.744精确率和0.593召回率。最大MPD宽度预测的平均绝对误差为0.355 mm，扩张MPD（≥5 mm）的检测灵敏度为75.0%，特异度为74.4%。这些新结果表明，自动MPD分割可用于辅助基于MRCP的胰管测量。

title: BRACHIO: Broad Representations Across Centres for Head-and-neck Imaging Oncology (HECKTOR 2026)

abstract: The HECKTOR 2026 challenge benchmarks machine learning for head and neck cancer, where teams delineate primary and nodal tumour volumes, perform TN staging, and predict recurrence-free survival (RFS). This report describes the submissions for the HECKTOR challenge of team nucli. As the three tasks span both dense and global information from multicentric PET/CT scans, we utilise self-supervised pre-trained encoders, training a 2D DINOv2 encoder (PET-DINOv2-MIPs) on HECKTOR 2026's PET scans. Our final test submission ensembles a DynUNet trained from scratch with a SwinUNETR whose Swin trunk was initialised from a SimMIM-pre-trained checkpoint for segmentation, reaching a mean Dice of 0.5409. For TN staging, GTVp/GTVn geometric features from the segmentation masks are fit to stage probabilities by logistic regression (LR) and fused with PET-DINOv2-MIPs deep features (PCA + LR) via a second-level LR, reaching balanced accuracies of 0.3962 (T-stage) and 0.6432 (N-stage). For the RFS prognosis task, we fine-tune the last two blocks of the PET-DINOv2-MIPs ViT-S encoder jointly with an MLP head under a CoxPH loss, concatenating clinical covariates with the imaging features, reaching a test Harrell's C-index of 0.6577 and a weighted challenge score of 0.5802. The prognosis result is comparable to the best entry of the previous edition and consistent with our internal cross-validation, while our segmentation result is well below it and limits the staging results that depend on it.
zh_abstract: HECKTOR 2026挑战赛对头颈癌机器学习进行基准评测，参赛团队需勾画原发灶和淋巴结肿瘤体积、进行TN分期，并预测无复发生存（RFS）。本报告描述nucli团队参加HECKTOR挑战赛的提交内容。由于这三项任务涉及多中心PET/CT扫描中的密集信息和全局信息，我们采用自监督预训练编码器，在HECKTOR 2026的PET扫描上训练二维DINOv2编码器（PET-DINOv2-MIPs）。我们最终的测试提交将从头训练的DynUNet与SwinUNETR集成用于分割，其中SwinUNETR的Swin主干由SimMIM预训练检查点初始化，达到平均Dice 0.5409。对于TN分期，将分割掩膜得到的GTVp/GTVn几何特征通过逻辑回归（LR）拟合为分期概率，并通过第二级LR与PET-DINOv2-MIPs深层特征（PCA + LR）融合，达到平衡准确率0.3962（T分期）和0.6432（N分期）。对于RFS预后任务，我们在CoxPH损失下联合微调PET-DINOv2-MIPs ViT-S编码器的最后两个模块与MLP头，并将临床协变量与影像特征拼接，达到测试Harrell's C指数0.6577和加权挑战赛评分0.5802。预后结果与上一届最佳参赛作品相当，并与我们的内部交叉验证一致，而我们的分割结果明显低于该水平，并限制了依赖其的分期结果。

title: Enhancing Atrial Fibrillation Detection Through Hyperparameter Optimization
zh_title: 超参数优化提升心房颤动检测性能
summary: 预印本比较多种机器学习与深度学习模型及四种超参数优化方法，在 PhysioNet 心电数据上检测房颤。
key_points: 采用患者间与患者内两种数据划分评估泛化
比较遗传算法、Hyperband、Optuna 与 SMAC3
Hyperband 优化的 XGBoost 最高 F1 为 96.95%
reason: 公开数据集上的调参对比预印本，方法增量有限，属增量档
abstract: This study explores the role of hyperparameter optimization (HPO) in enhancing the detection of Atrial Fibrillation (AF) using both machine learning and deep learning models. We evaluated a range of standard classifiers - Decision Tree, Random Forest, and XGBoost classifiers, alongside deep learning architectures including Recurrent Neural Networks, Deep Neural Networks, and Siamese Neural Networks. To fine-tune these models, we applied four HPO methods: Genetic Algorithm, Hyperband, Optuna, and SMAC3. The experiments were conducted using inter-patient and intra- patient data splits to assess model generalization and robustness in the presence of class imbalance, which is reflective of real-world AF occurrence. Our results, based on PhysioNet electrocardiogram datasets, showed that the Hyperband-optimized XGBoost model outperformed all others, achieving a peak F1 score of 96.95%. These findings highlight the critical role of suitable HPO strategies in enhancing the accuracy and robustness of AF classification outcomes in clinical settings.
zh_abstract: 本研究探讨超参数优化（HPO）在利用机器学习和深度学习模型增强心房颤动（AF）检测中的作用。我们评估了一系列标准分类器——决策树、随机森林和XGBoost分类器，以及包括循环神经网络、深度神经网络和孪生神经网络在内的深度学习架构。为微调这些模型，我们应用了四种HPO方法：遗传算法、Hyperband、Optuna和SMAC3。实验采用患者间和患者内数据划分，以评估模型在类别不平衡情况下的泛化性和稳健性，这种类别不平衡反映了真实世界中AF的发生情况。我们基于PhysioNet心电图数据集的结果显示，经Hyperband优化的XGBoost模型优于所有其他模型，达到96.95%的峰值F1分数。这些发现凸显了合适的HPO策略在提高临床环境中AF分类结果的准确性和稳健性方面的关键作用。

abstract: Failures of deployed clinical artificial intelligence (AI) systems have often originated in how their training data were generated. Whether the programs that train the health AI workforce teach practitioners to examine data provenance is unknown. We conducted a cross-sectional analysis of the publicly advertised curricula of health AI education programs at U.S. universities, identified through a structured multisource web search between April and July 2026. Two investigators coded coverage of data provenance (structural, dataset limitations, or data management only), ethics, and sustainability; collaborative structure; technical prerequisites; and the disciplinary background and gender of named instructors. The primary outcome was provenance coverage at the structural or dataset-limitations level. Of 43 candidate entries, 36 programs at 25 institutional units in 21 universities were included. Ethics was covered by 29 programs (80.6%; 95% confidence interval [CI], 65.0 to 90.2), data provenance by 8 (22.2%; 95% CI, 11.7 to 38.1), and structural provenance by 6 (16.7%; 95% CI, 7.9 to 31.9). None of the seven master's degree programs met the primary outcome, and no program addressed sustainability. Eighteen programs included team-based work, but only 5 assembled teams across clinical and technical backgrounds. Of 92 named instructors, 76.1% came from computational disciplines and 3.3% from the social sciences or humanities; among the 51 whose gender could be determined, 66.7% were men. U.S. health AI education programs widely taught ethics but rarely taught how clinical data are produced. None addressed the environmental cost of computation, and most instructors came from computational disciplines.
zh_abstract: 已部署的临床人工智能（AI）系统的失败，常常源于其训练数据的生成方式。培养健康AI人才队伍的项目是否教从业者审查数据溯源，尚不清楚。我们于2026年4月至7月通过结构化多来源网络搜索识别美国大学的健康AI教育项目，并对其公开宣传的课程进行了横断面分析。两名研究者对以下内容的覆盖情况进行编码：数据溯源（结构性、数据集局限性或仅数据管理）、伦理和可持续性；协作结构；技术先修要求；以及具名讲师的学科背景和性别。主要结局为结构性或数据集局限性层面的数据溯源覆盖。在43个候选条目中，纳入了21所大学25个机构单位的36个项目。29个项目覆盖伦理（80.6%；95%置信区间[CI]，65.0至90.2），8个覆盖数据溯源（22.2%；95% CI，11.7至38.1），6个覆盖结构性溯源（16.7%；95% CI，7.9至31.9）。七个硕士项目均未达到主要结局，且没有项目涉及可持续性。18个项目包含团队合作，但只有5个组建了跨临床和技术背景的团队。在92名具名讲师中，76.1%来自计算学科，3.3%来自社会科学或人文学科；在51名可确定性别者中，66.7%为男性。美国健康AI教育项目广泛教授伦理，但很少教授临床数据如何产生。没有项目涉及计算的环境成本，且大多数讲师来自计算学科。

title: Artificial Intelligence for Microbial Colony Analysis: Plate-Reading Challenges, Method Selection, and Validation.
zh_title: 微生物菌落分析的AI方法：读板挑战、方法选择与验证
summary: 综述梳理菌落计数中的真实读板难点，并将这些难点对应到传统方法、检测与分割模型及验证要求。
key_points: 列举拥挤、碎片、皿缘干扰与低对比等问题
比较阈值/形态学、检测与各类分割方法

reason: 方法学综述，无新数据，按规则最高6分，取4分
abstract: [Microorganisms] Microbial colony analysis is routinely used in clinical microbiology, pharmaceutical quality control, food safety, and environmental monitoring. Colony enumeration remains challenging because real-world plates frequently show crowding, size variation, background debris, and plate-rim interference. Low contrast on membrane or filter media, weak colony boundaries, and ultra-dense or too-numerous-to-count (TNTC) growth further complicate analysis. These conditions increase counting variability and limit rule-based counters. This review examines artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled colony analysis and links recurrent plate-reading challenges to method selection and validation requirements. We examine traditional threshold- and morphology-based pipelines, object detection, semantic segmentation, instance segmentation, and density- or keypoint-based estimation. Current evidence is stronger for plate-level triage and semi-quantitative interpretation than for direct colony enumeration. However, evidence supporting routine quantitative colony-forming unit (CFU) reporting across laboratories remains limited. Reliable deployment requires methods suited to plate format, organism, imaging conditions, and intended use, with validation in the target workflow.
zh_abstract: [Microorganisms] 微生物菌落分析常规用于临床微生物学、制药质量控制、食品安全和环境监测。菌落计数仍然具有挑战性，因为真实世界平板经常出现拥挤、大小不一、背景碎片和平板边缘干扰。膜或滤材上的低对比度、弱菌落边界，以及超密集或多到无法计数（too-numerous-to-count，TNTC）的生长，进一步使分析复杂化。这些情况增加计数变异性并限制基于规则的计数器。本综述考察人工智能（AI）赋能的菌落分析，并将反复出现的平板判读挑战与方法选择和验证要求联系起来。我们考察传统的基于阈值和形态学的流程、目标检测、语义分割、实例分割，以及基于密度或关键点的估计。当前证据对平板级分诊和半定量解读的支持强于对直接菌落计数的支持。然而，支持跨实验室常规定量报告菌落形成单位（CFU）的证据仍然有限。可靠部署需要适合平板规格、微生物、成像条件和预期用途的方法，并在目标工作流程中进行验证。

title: Fisher Contrastive Learning to Mitigate Feature Suppression: A Case Study in Acute Promyelocytic Leukemia Diagnosis
zh_title: Fisher对比学习缓解特征抑制：APL诊断
summary: 提出Fisher对比学习，用正则化Fisher迹准则缓解自监督对比学习的特征抑制，并用于急性早幼粒细胞白血病诊断。
key_points: 针对特征抑制问题提出FCL方法
给出缓解特征抑制的理论证明
在模拟基准与真实生物医学数据上验证
reason: 方法类预印本，应用验证规模与效果有限，属增量
abstract: Self-supervised contrastive learning (SSCL) learns representations by contrasting augmented views of the same sample, but it can exhibit feature suppression, where dominant or easy-to-learn factors suppress other class-relevant signals, degrading the performance of representations, particularly in high-dimensional data with heterogeneous features. We introduce Fisher Contrastive Learning (FCL), which uses a regularized Fisher trace criterion to address feature suppression. FCL learns embeddings by maximizing the discriminative strength of Fisher discriminant functions, producing representations that preserve class-relevant information implied by the augmentation process. We prove that the representations learned by FCL could alleviate the feature suppression effects. We demonstrate FCL on simulated benchmarks designed to induce feature suppression and on a real-world biomedical application, pretraining on large white blood cell microscopy image dataset and transfer learning for diagnosis of acute promyelocytic leukemia in an external cohort. In all experiments, FCL outperforms the self-supervised baselines and yields more robust and discriminative representations.
zh_abstract: 自监督对比学习（Self-supervised contrastive learning, SSCL）通过对比同一样本的增强视图来学习表示，但它可能出现特征抑制，即主导性或易学习因素压制其他类别相关信号，从而降低表示性能，尤其是在具有异质特征的高维数据中。我们提出Fisher对比学习（Fisher Contrastive Learning, FCL），使用正则化Fisher迹准则来处理特征抑制。FCL通过最大化Fisher判别函数的判别强度来学习嵌入，产生保留增强过程所隐含的类别相关信息的表示。我们证明FCL学到的表示可以缓解特征抑制效应。我们在旨在诱导特征抑制的模拟基准上，以及在一个真实世界生物医学应用中展示FCL：在大型白细胞显微图像数据集上预训练，并在外部队列中迁移学习用于急性早幼粒细胞白血病诊断。在所有实验中，FCL均优于自监督基线，并产生更稳健、更具判别性的表示。

abstract: Accurate lung tumor segmentation in computed tomography (CT) is essential for treatment planning, response assessment, and quantitative imaging analysis. However, 3D lung tumor segmentation remains challenging because tumors occupy only a small portion of the whole volume and exhibit heterogeneous appearances across anatomical locations. In patch-based training and sliding-window inference for 3D medical image segmentation, location-dependent heterogeneity is further amplified because cropped image patches provide limited global anatomical context, making it difficult for a model to adapt its feature processing according to the anatomical region from which each patch is extracted. To address this limitation, we propose an Anatomical Prior-guided Routing Module (APRM) for lung tumor segmentation. For each image patch, we obtain anatomical prior information of regional occupancy and deterministically select an anatomical routing gate. The selected gate then performs sparse feature routing over a shared expert adapter pool, enabling anatomy-specific feature adaptation while sharing expert capacity across regions. We evaluate APRM on two datasets with various backbone networks and demonstrate consistent improvements over baseline models. Furthermore, feature visualizations show that APRM produces different feature responses depending on patch location, indicating that the proposed routing mechanism effectively adapts feature processing according to anatomical context.
zh_abstract: 在计算机断层扫描（computed tomography, CT）中准确分割肺部肿瘤对于治疗计划、疗效评估和定量影像分析至关重要。然而，3D 肺部肿瘤分割仍然具有挑战性，因为肿瘤仅占整个体积的一小部分，并且在不同解剖位置表现出异质性外观。在用于 3D 医学图像分割的基于图像块（patch）的训练和滑动窗口推理中，位置依赖性异质性被进一步放大，因为裁剪出的图像块提供的全局解剖背景有限，使模型难以根据每个图像块所提取的解剖区域来调整其特征处理。为解决这一局限，我们提出一种用于肺部肿瘤分割的解剖先验引导路由模块（Anatomical Prior-guided Routing Module, APRM）。对于每个图像块，我们获取区域占用的解剖先验信息，并确定性地选择一个解剖路由门。随后，所选门在共享专家适配器池上执行稀疏特征路由，从而在跨区域共享专家容量的同时实现解剖特异性的特征适应。我们在两个数据集上使用多种骨干网络评估 APRM，并证明相对于基线模型具有一致的改进。此外，特征可视化显示，APRM 会根据图像块位置产生不同的特征响应，表明所提出的路由机制能够根据解剖背景有效调整特征处理。

title: EPC-RawDC: Equivariant Physics Constrained 3D Diffusion with Raw Data Consistency for CBCT to CT Image Synthesis
zh_title: EPC-RawDC：面向CBCT到CT合成的等变物理约束3D扩散
summary: 提出结合几何等变投影约束与原始数据一致性的3D潜扩散框架，用于CBCT到CT图像合成。
key_points: 融合扫描仪特定CBCT前向模型的物理约束
几何等变投影约束与原始数据一致性双重监督
目标为提升CBCT的定量可用性

abstract: Cone beam computed tomography (CBCT) is widely used for image guided and adaptive radiotherapy, but scatter, noise, reconstruction artifacts, and inaccurate Hounsfield units limit its quantitative use. Recent diffusion approaches for CBCT to CT synthesis remain largely image driven, with limited use of the underlying acquisition physics. We propose EPC-RawDC, a conditional 3D latent diffusion framework that combines volumetric generative modeling with two complementary constraints derived from the same scanner specific CBCT forward model. First, geometry equivariant projection constraint exploits the rotational equivariance of the CBCT forward operator by supervising the synthesized CT through correspondingly transformed reference projections. Second, raw data consistency uses noisy projection measurements of the individual acquisition as scan specific supervision during training. The framework was evaluated on two independent clinical cohorts with distinct scanner geometries and projection sources. For JUST, the physics constraints used measured clinical raw CBCT projections acquired with an Elekta system, whereas for SynthRAD2025 the projection data were simulated from the reference CT using a Varian geometry with Poisson photon statistics. EPC-RawDC achieved an SSIM of 0.97 in both cohorts and improved PSNR over DDPM by 2.66 dB on SynthRAD2025 and 2.10 dB on JUST, while reducing mean MAE by 20.3% and 19.0%, respectively. On SynthRAD2025, projection consistency and equivariant errors were reduced by 55.0% and 41.4% relative to DDPM. These results demonstrate that combining a volumetric diffusion prior with scanner geometry and scan specific projection measurements improves quantitative CBCT to CT synthesis across both simulated and measured projection domains. Code available after publication at https://github.com/ALZAHRAALTALIB/EPC-RawDC.
zh_abstract: 锥形束计算机断层扫描（CBCT）广泛用于图像引导和自适应放疗，但散射、噪声、重建伪影和不准确的Hounsfield单位限制了其定量应用。近期用于CBCT到CT合成的扩散方法在很大程度上仍是图像驱动的，对底层采集物理的利用有限。我们提出EPC-RawDC，一种条件3D潜扩散框架，将体数据生成建模与源自同一扫描仪特定CBCT前向模型的两个互补约束相结合。首先，几何等变投影约束利用CBCT前向算子的旋转等变性，通过相应变换的参考投影对合成CT进行监督。其次，原始数据一致性在训练期间使用单次采集的含噪投影测量作为扫描特定监督。该框架在两个独立的临床队列上评估，这些队列具有不同的扫描仪几何结构和投影来源。对于JUST，物理约束使用由Elekta系统采集的临床原始CBCT投影测量；而对于SynthRAD2025，投影数据是使用Varian几何结构和泊松光子统计从参考CT模拟的。EPC-RawDC在两个队列中均达到0.97的SSIM，并在SynthRAD2025和JUST上将PSNR较DDPM分别提高2.66 dB和2.10 dB，同时将平均MAE分别降低20.3%和19.0%。在SynthRAD2025上，投影一致性和等变误差相对于DDPM分别降低55.0%和41.4%。这些结果表明，将体数据扩散先验与扫描仪几何结构和扫描特定投影测量相结合，可在模拟和实测投影域中改善定量CBCT到CT合成。代码将在发表后提供，网址为 https://github.com/ALZAHRAALTALIB/EPC-RawDC。

title: Learning a Motion Manifold to Constrain Ambiguity in Unsupervised 4D Medical Image Interpolation
zh_title: 学习运动流形约束无监督4D医学图像插值歧义
summary: 提出学习运动流形以约束无监督4D医学图像插值中的运动歧义，并保留样本特异性变化。
key_points: 跨样本谱基学习提取共性运动结构
样本条件Cayley基重定向旋转运动方向
不增加独立运动变量数量
reason: 预印本技术方法，缺少外部验证与临床评估
abstract: Unsupervised 4D medical image interpolation reconstructs intermediate anatomical states from temporally sparse observations without intermediate supervision. Distinct motion fields may attain comparable endpoint agreement while producing different intermediate anatomy, giving rise to motion ambiguity. This ambiguity is difficult to constrain when many independently adjustable motion variables must be estimated from the observed endpoints. We develop a framework that learns a motion manifold to restrict candidate motion fields while retaining sample-specific variation. Cross-Sample Spectral Basis Learning extracts recurring motion structure from endpoint-derived dense estimates and encodes it in a shared spectral basis. Sample-Conditioned Cayley Basis Reorientation uses predicted motion coordinates to rotate the effective motion directions for each endpoint pair without increasing the number of independent coordinates. Their composition defines a nonlinear family of complete velocity fields across endpoint pairs, accommodating anatomical and motion-state differences within a restricted representation. Integrating each predicted field supports bidirectional reconstruction at arbitrary intermediate times. Theoretical analysis establishes sufficient conditions under which endpoint observations distinguish nearby motions within the learned family. Experiments on ACDC and 4D-Lung demonstrate state-of-the-art performance among the evaluated methods trained without intermediate volumes and competitive results against methods using intermediate supervision.
zh_abstract: 无监督4D医学图像插值在没有中间监督的情况下，从时间上稀疏的观测重建中间解剖状态。不同的运动场可能达到可比的端点一致性，却产生不同的中间解剖结构，从而引起运动歧义。当必须从观测到的端点估计许多可独立调节的运动变量时，这种歧义难以约束。我们开发了一个框架，学习运动流形以限制候选运动场，同时保留样本特异性变异。跨样本光谱基学习（Cross-Sample Spectral Basis Learning）从端点导出的稠密估计中提取反复出现的运动结构，并将其编码到共享光谱基中。样本条件Cayley基重定向（Sample-Conditioned Cayley Basis Reorientation）使用预测的运动坐标来旋转每个端点对的有效运动方向，而不增加独立坐标的数量。它们的组合定义了跨端点对的完整速度场的非线性族，在受限表示内适应解剖和运动状态差异。对每个预测场进行积分支持任意中间时间的双向重建。理论分析建立了充分条件，在这些条件下，端点观测能够区分所学运动族内的邻近运动。在ACDC和4D-Lung上的实验表明，在未使用中间体积训练的评估方法中达到最先进性能，并相对于使用中间监督的方法具有竞争力。

title: Confidence Filtering in Video-Based Gait Assessment: Measurement Error versus Selection Shift
zh_title: 视频步态评估中的置信度过滤：测量误差与选择偏移
summary: 在帕金森相关队列（n=96）与 NF2 复制队列（n=18）中比较置信度过滤与预算匹配随机选择对步态评估的影响。
key_points: 置信度过滤使运动摘要指标小幅一致偏移 +0.05 SD
留出集 Mini-BESTest 误差无明显变化
NF2 队列未见偏移，预测器未优于常数基线
reason: 小样本方法学预印本，含复制队列但预测未超基线，属增量档
abstract: Video-based gait assessment often keeps only high-confidence pose observations, which can lower measurement error but change the movement assessed. We compared confidence selection with budget-matched random selection in a Parkinson-related cohort (n = 96) and an NF2-related replication cohort (n = 18). In the Parkinson-related cohort, confidence selection produced a small but consistent shift in the observed movement summary (+0.05 SD, 95% CI 0.03 to 0.07), while held-out Mini-BESTest error stayed flat (-0.04 points, -0.13 to 0.05); a policy preserving motion-group proportions reduced the shift, while NF2 showed no shift and its predictor did not beat a constant baseline. Because this shift mixes measurement error with selection shift, we decompose and simulate both on the cohort's window structure. Filtering lowers local error when error depends on confidence, but biases the endpoint once confidence tracks movement more than error. In the Parkinson-related data, confidence was only weakly tied to movement (rho = 0.14). There, filtering is harmless if well-tracked windows are unbiased. If instead systematic error only redistributes within participants, filtering can add up to 0.58 degrees. Unchanged clinical error from such small-cohort predictors therefore cannot show that quality filtering preserves the assessed movement.
zh_abstract: 基于视频的步态评估通常只保留高置信度的姿态观测，这可能降低测量误差，但会改变所评估的运动。我们在一个帕金森病相关队列（n = 96）和一个NF2相关重复验证队列（n = 18）中，比较了置信度选择与预算匹配的随机选择。在帕金森病相关队列中，置信度选择使观测到的运动汇总指标产生小幅但一致的偏移（+0.05 SD，95% CI 0.03 至 0.07），而留出的 Mini-BESTest 误差保持平稳（-0.04 分，-0.13 至 0.05）；一种保留运动组比例的方案减小了该偏移，而 NF2 队列未显示偏移，其预测器也未优于常数基线。由于该偏移混合了测量误差与选择偏移，我们基于该队列的窗口结构对二者进行分解和模拟。当误差取决于置信度时，过滤会降低局部误差，但一旦置信度对运动的跟踪强于对误差的跟踪，就会使终点产生偏倚。在帕金森病相关数据中，置信度与运动仅呈弱相关（rho = 0.14）。在那里，如果跟踪良好的窗口无偏，过滤是无害的。反之，如果系统性误差仅在参与者内部重新分布，过滤最多可增加 0.58 度。因此，此类小队列预测器临床误差未发生变化，并不能证明质量过滤保留了所评估的运动。

title: DOSE: Dominance-Guided Ordinal Severity Estimation from Sparse Relative Annotations

abstract: Medical severity estimation commonly relies on absolute grade annotations, which are fundamentally ordinal, yet existing methods often treat the grades as independent categories. Learning-to-rank methods, which can be trained using relative annotations based on severity comparisons of image pairs, can provide continuous severity rankings but cannot directly predict discrete severity grades. We propose Dominance-guided Ordinal Severity Estimation from Sparse Relative Annotations (DOSE), a framework for learning ordinal medical severity from sparse pairwise comparisons without using absolute annotations. DOSE aggregates the observed comparisons through a global comparison graph to estimate a dominance score for each image. Differences between dominance scores set cumulative margins in the embedding space, so that pairs with larger estimated severity differences are separated more strongly, and also generate pseudo-pairs that supervise a scalar severity head alongside the observed comparisons. The learned continuous severity axis is converted into discrete grades via label-free score calibration, with tie-anchored segmentation as the main calibration method. In the experiment, DOSE consistently outperformed pairwise-ranking baselines on ACNE04, IDRiD, and LIMUC under different pair budgets. Code is available at https://github.com/TushirSahu/DOSE
zh_abstract: 医学严重程度估计通常依赖绝对等级标注，而这些等级本质上是序数性的，但现有方法常将等级视为独立类别。学习排序（learning-to-rank）方法可利用基于图像对严重程度比较的相对标注进行训练，能够提供连续的严重程度排序，但无法直接预测离散的严重程度等级。我们提出基于稀疏相对标注的优势引导序数严重程度估计（Dominance-guided Ordinal Severity Estimation from Sparse Relative Annotations，DOSE）框架，可在不使用绝对标注的情况下从稀疏成对比较中学习序数性医学严重程度。DOSE 通过全局比较图聚合观测到的比较，为每张图像估计优势分数（dominance score）。优势分数之间的差异在嵌入空间中设定累积间隔（cumulative margins），使估计严重程度差异较大的图像对更强地被分开，同时生成伪图像对，与观测到的比较一起监督一个标量严重程度头。学习到的连续严重程度轴通过无标签分数校准转换为离散等级，其中并列锚定分割（tie-anchored segmentation）是主要校准方法。在实验中，DOSE 在不同图像对预算下于 ACNE04、IDRiD 和 LIMUC 上持续优于成对排序基线。代码见 https://github.com/TushirSahu/DOSE

abstract: Medical image segmentation is crucial for clinical diagnosis and treatment planning, requiring both global contextual understanding and fine-grained structural precision. While the Segment Anything Model (SAM) demonstrates strong generalization capabilities, its direct application to medical images often lacks domain-specific adaptability. Meanwhile, State Space Models (SSMs)-based methods, such as Mamba, efficiently capture long-range dependencies but may struggle with preserving fine anatomical details. To address these challenges, we propose a segment anything model based context guided mamba unet, SAMBA-UNet, a novel framework that integrates SAM's context knowledge with Mamba's hierarchical feature learning to enhance both global representation and local detail refinement. Specifically, we introduce the Hierarchical Context Enhancement Module (HCEM), an attention-based fusion module that deeply incorporates the multi-level features of SAM and Mamba to improve detail perception and segmentation precision. Additionally, we employ LoRA and Adapter-based fine-tuning to adapt SAM to medical imaging tasks, further enhancing its domain-specific segmentation capability and robustness. We conducted a comprehensive study on several medical segmentation datasets, including Synapse, ISIC17, and ISIC18, evaluating our method across multiple metrics. Experimental results demonstrate that SAMBA-UNet achieves state-of-the-art performance, effectively balancing generalization, segmentation accuracy, and computational efficiency. Our code will be released upon acceptance.
zh_abstract: 医学图像分割对临床诊断和治疗计划至关重要，既需要全局上下文理解，也需要细粒度结构精度。尽管Segment Anything Model（SAM）展现出强大的泛化能力，但其直接应用于医学图像时往往缺乏领域特定的适应性。与此同时，基于状态空间模型（SSM）的方法（如Mamba）能高效捕获长程依赖关系，但在保留精细解剖细节方面可能存在困难。为应对这些挑战，我们提出一种基于Segment Anything Model的上下文引导Mamba U-Net——SAMBA-UNet，这是一种新颖框架，将SAM的上下文知识与Mamba的层次化特征学习相结合，以同时增强全局表征和局部细节细化。具体而言，我们引入层次化上下文增强模块（HCEM），这是一种基于注意力的融合模块，深度融合SAM和Mamba的多层次特征，以改善细节感知和分割精度。此外，我们采用LoRA和基于Adapter的微调使SAM适应医学影像任务，进一步增强其领域特定分割能力和鲁棒性。我们在多个医学分割数据集（包括Synapse、ISIC17和ISIC18）上开展了全面研究，并在多项指标上评估我们的方法。实验结果表明，SAMBA-UNet达到最先进性能，有效平衡了泛化性、分割准确性和计算效率。我们的代码将在论文被接收后发布。
